questions.question:
Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following sets.

(NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. E.g. 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding/deleting/multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed)

(4, 9, 95)

(6, 10, 134)
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: (1st number)² + (2nd number)² - 2 = 3rd number.

Now,

For, (4, 9, 95)

⇒ (4)² + (9)² - 2 = 16 + 81 - 2 = 95.

For, (6, 10, 134)

⇒ (6)2 + (10)2 - 2 = 36 + 100 - 2 = 134.

Similarly, for **(8, 11, 183)**

**⇒ (8)² + (11)² - 2 = 64 + 121 - 2 = 183.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".

questions.question:
Two statements are given, followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements :**

All trees are greens.

Some trees are conifers.

**Conclusions:**

I. All conifers are greens.

II. Some greens are trees.

options.text: Neither Conclusion I nor II follows.
Both Conclusions I and II follow.

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a538050c1d032cb20999cce34b8581679b9747becf75a4d2da8a901028d468ab.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All conifers are greens → Does not follow (As all trees are greens and some trees are conifers. So it is possible but not definite.)

II. Some greens are trees → Follow (As some trees are conifers. As some part of trees is common with conifers, therefore it is true.)

∴ Here, Only conclusion II follows.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".

questions.question:
If + means ÷, − means +, × means – and ÷ means ×, what is the value of the following expressions?

20 ÷ 4 – 27 + 3 × 12 =?
questions.solution:
Given Equation: 20 ÷ 4 – 27 + 3 × 12 = ?

BODMAS Rule:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a45b5b9191c13cd4da310eb8df100becb078c240f4b0e763420ec154fb42a5fd.png] 

Decoding the given information:

 
 

 Symbol
 +
 –
 ×
 ÷
 
 
 
 

 Meaning
 ÷
 +
 –
 ×
 
 

 

Now replacing the sign from left to right using BODMAS Rule, we get:

⇒ 20 × 4 + __**27 ÷ 3**__ – 12 = ?

⇒ __**20 × 4**__ + 9 – 12 = ?

⇒ __**80 + 9**__ – 12 = ?

⇒ __**89 – 12**__ = **77.**

Hence, the correct option is "Option 4".
